title: Meta just dropped SAM 3D, you can auto select any object in still image and.. turn them into high quality 3D model
author: oVerde

comments.author: Bigger_moss
comments.body:
I like the idea but as always, is topology good or unusable completely? Can you use it for characters? Are they riggable? 

Stuff like this keeps popping up and ending up disappointing.

replies.author: Segaiai
replies.body:
I don't see any benefit at all in using the human models as character models. They have no details, and you might as well use any of the thousands of great base models out there with actual rigs. The point of them is to get poses and depth maps. But from the video, the SAM3 human models have bones. The usefulness of that is definitely there, but not in game development that I can see. 

I mean, maybe it can be applied to video for motion capture? I just think they would have shown that if it were possible. I really think it wouldn't be able to do that. 

The environment object models should definitely be usable in games though, from what I've seen.
